quarterlyKpis.commentary: GST cut on <=350cc motorcycles (28% to 18%) and rise on >350cc (31% to 40%) from 22-Sep-2025; revenue +45% YoY. Volume rounded to thousands (MOSL table).
Record festive season (+26%); first quarter above 3 lakh domestic. Volume rounded to thousands (MOSL table).
Commodity impact ~90bp, offset by a 0.70% blended price rise in Jan-2026 and cost reduction; EBITDA margin 24.9%.

quarterlyKpis.marginDrivers: Revenue +31.5%, EBITDA margin 24.0% (gross margin 41.5%, -270bp YoY): net commodity and process-cost impact 4-4.5%, offset by the 1.75% Apr-2026 price rise on most 350cc models (~1.2%), value engineering (0.4%), mix (0.2%) and ~Rs52 cr lower other expenses (no Cricket World Cup campaign, no launches). Depreciation +40% on Flying Flea and Cheyyar capitalisation.

monthly._note: Monthly sales releases (dispatches incl. exports). Sep-2026 volumes are released in early October, after our as-of date, and are not used.

callPoints: Highest-ever quarter: 332,940 motorcycles (+27%), 301,174 in India and 31,766 abroad; 350cc models (Classic, Bullet, Hunter, Meteor) +34%; Guerrilla 450 ~2,400-2,500 a month and the 650 twins ~4,000-4,200 a month, back to pre-GST levels.
Dealer stock only 10-12 days (plus ~5 days in transit); enquiries, walk-ins and bookings growing faster than volumes; direct billing to dealers rising (to ~4.5-4.7% of volume) to save 4-5 days.

Capacity 1.5 mn after the first Cheyyar module (late Jul-2026, ~5,000+ a day); next module in early Oct-2026; 2.0 mn by FY27-28; Board approved Rs1,225 cr for Tada (Andhra Pradesh) phase 1, +0.45 mn by FY2029-30 (2.45 mn in total).
Commodity inflation (aluminium, steel, copper, precious metals, crude) net 4-4.5% of cost; 'softening' now but no guidance.
Flying Flea C6 (EV) on sale in one Bengaluru store from Apr-2026, deliveries from Jun-2026 (100+); 10 Bengaluru touchpoints planned, then ~6 more cities one by one.

International revenue above Rs1,000 cr for the first time (15.3% of revenue); Brazil is the biggest market outside India (#2 in middleweight); US slow (tariffs), Europe in 'market adjustment', Indonesia quota (~10,000 a year) being tackled with a local CKD assembler.
Buyers: ~25% first-time, 70%+ upgraders from other brands, 5-6% existing RE owners; allied revenue (spares, service, accessories, apparel) ~15% of revenue, accessories penetration 87%.
No plan to list VECV for now ('the focus is on EV').

guidance.said: Rs958 cr brownfield expansion at Cheyyar to take capacity to ~2 mn.
guidance.outcome: First module live late Jul-2026 (1.5 mn); 2 mn by Q2FY28 (May-2026 call).

guidance.said: 3-3.5% material-cost inflation in Q1; 1.75% price rise in April recovers about half.
guidance.outcome: Actual net hit 4-4.5% in Q1; margin 24.0%.

guidance.said: No numeric guidance; enquiries +23%; 'no structural correction' in premium demand; April +57% domestic.
50:50 JV with Volvo Financial Services India; Eicher to invest up to Rs750 cr; no more capital needed for ~5 years.
Focus stays on 250-750cc; S6 (EV) and Bullet 650 on track.
No forward guidance on commodities; marketing to be ramped up again.

timeline.event: Enfield India formed with Madras Motors; Chennai factory.
Eicher Group acquires Enfield India; renamed Royal Enfield Motors.
VECV formed: Volvo-Eicher JV (Volvo 45.6%, Eicher 54.4%); Eicher's own truck business moved into it.
Oragadam plant; Royal Enfield volumes take off (Classic 350).
Vallam Vadagal plant; UK tech centre at Bruntingthorpe.
650 twins (Interceptor, Continental GT); Eicher Polaris JV wound down (Rs220 cr share of loss).
J-platform 350s (Meteor, new Classic, Hunter); FY21-22 volumes hit by Covid and chip shortages.
Sherpa 450 (Himalayan 450, Guerrilla 450); Super Meteor, Shotgun, Bear 650; Stark Future (EV) stake for EUR50 mn.
China curbs rare-earth magnet exports; 450cc output disrupted in Q1FY26.
GST 2.0: <=350cc motorcycles 28% to 18%; >350cc 31% (28% + 3% cess) to 40%. RE passes the full cut (up to Rs22,000 on 350s).
Rs958 cr Cheyyar brownfield approved (Siddhartha Lal has been executive chairman and B. Govindarajan MD since 13-Feb-2025).
Flying Flea C6 (first EV) launched in Bengaluru at Rs2.79 lakh (Rs1.99 lakh with battery-as-a-service); deliveries from 19-Jun-2026.
Plan for a 50:50 vehicle-finance JV with Volvo Financial Services India (up to Rs750 cr).
Rs1,225 cr approved for the Tada (Andhra Pradesh) greenfield, phase 1: +0.45 mn by FY2029-30.
